units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> <he>שנ׳ לבו עליו</he> Ar. (ed. <he>נתגאה</he>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 37">Ex. R. s. 37</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00151"><he>זוּחַ</he> I</cite>) whose heart within him was unsteady (whose mind was unbalanced, who was wanton).

senses.gloss: to make unsteady. Part. pass. מוּזָּז, pl. מוּזִּין staggering, reeling. Pesik. Zutr. Haăz., ed. Bub. p. 115 (expl. מזי רעב, Deut. XXXII, 24) שיהו מ׳ … מפני הרעב they shall be reeling and shall fall on the dunghill from hunger; Sifré Deut. 321 מאווים ברעב (or מאוזים, read: מוּזָּזִים) staggering in starvation; Yalk. ib. 945 מוּוָּחִין, v. נָזַח.
